headline: Google releases styleguide for AI code review in healthcare systems
body: Google published updated code review guidelines that emphasize AI-assisted development practices, gaining significant traction across developer communities. For healthcare AI teams, this matters because code quality directly impacts EHR integration reliability and clinical workflow automation safety. Healthcare organizations adopting AI tools for documentation, diagnostics, or administrative tasks depend on robust code review processes to meet compliance requirements and reduce deployment risks. The styleguide provides practical frameworks that healthcare software vendors and enterprise IT teams can implement to strengthen their AI implementation practices.
